content: Pleasant words spoken with a smiling face are better than a lavish gift given with a cold heart.
author: Thiruvalluvar
sourceWork: Tirukkural, Chapter 10 (Sweet Speech / Iniyavai Kural), Couplet 92
explanation:
Human beings do not live on material goods alone; the soul hungers for genuine warmth, dignity, and gracious recognition. A wealthy benefactor who gives gifts with condescension leaves a bitter taste in the heart, while a humble person who offers sweet, sincere words with an open countenance elevates everyone around them. Gracious speech costs nothing, yet it enriches the world more than gold.

Let your words be gentle balms that heal, rather than sharp daggers that wound.
practicalInsight: Make a conscious effort in every conversation today to speak with genuine warmth, patience, and an open smile.
reflectionPrompt: How can you soften your tone when communicating under stress so that your words build bridges rather than walls?
